versions.changelog:
Data Analyst Partner skill – initial release

- Provides a structured approach for Grafana-first product and business data analysis support.
- Defines four main request categories: dashboard interpretation, split/rerun, new analysis, and new dashboard.
- Establishes a standard workflow: identify request, check Grafana first, escalate only if necessary, and answer as an analyst.
- Introduces a daily report template focused on actionable, comparative metrics.
- Lists quality rules to ensure clarity, source attribution, and correct escalation.
- Includes a confirmation checklist before creating new dashboards.
